name: Virtual Context
description: Integrates OpenClaw with virtual-context.com for unlimited memory, compressed LLM payloads, and memory retrieval tools.

vcKey.description: Virtual Context API key (sent as vckey query parameter)

baseUrl.description: VC REST API base URL (default: https://api.virtual-context.com)

providers.description: List of provider/model strings to activate for (e.g. ["openai-direct/gpt-5.4"]). Empty or omitted = all providers.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging of REST API calls, payloads, and responses. Default: false.

convIdentity.description: Conversation identity mode: 'session' keys VC conversations by the rotating OpenClaw session UUID (legacy); 'stable' keys durable chat scopes by their session key so memory survives session rotation.

conversationGroups.description: Map of group session key -> member session keys. Every member shares the group key's stable VC conversation. Requires convIdentity="stable". Exact stable keys are supported; a terminal agent:<agent>:discord:channel:* wildcard is accepted only when OpenClaw binds that agent to an allowlisted Discord account with exactly one explicit guild, and the group key names that guild. Discord DMs and group DMs remain separate.

observeGuildMessages.description: Admit non-dispatched Discord guild messages into their certified conversationGroup as user-only VC observations through a receive-only Discord Gateway session. DMs are always excluded. This does not invoke the agent or read OpenClaw transcripts. Disabled by default.

observeBotUserId.description: Discord user id of the OpenClaw bot. Required when observeGuildMessages is enabled; the observer verifies this identity at Gateway READY and rejects bot-authored messages.

observeDiscordAccountId.description: OpenClaw Discord account whose already-resolved in-memory bot token is used for the receive-only observation Gateway session. The token is never logged or read from conversation files.

observeQueueMax.description: Maximum queued guild observations awaiting cloud delivery.

observeFallbackDelayMs.description: Delay before a Gateway message is delivered as an observation. Any message OpenClaw actually dispatches cancels the pending observation first, independent of content semantics.
